tools.name: estimate_blood_alcohol
tools.description: Estimate blood alcohol concentration in permille (g/kg, the German unit; 0.5 permille = 0.05 % BAC) from body data and drinks, using Widmark with Watson body water, a 10-30 % resorption deficit and 0.1-0.2 permille/h elimination. Returns the peak and current value as a range and conservative hours u

tools.name: list_drinks
tools.description: Typical German drink servings with volume, alcohol by volume and grams of pure alcohol. Use the ids in estimate_blood_alcohol.

tools.name: german_drink_driving_limits
tools.description: The blood alcohol limits in German road traffic (0.0, 0.3, 0.5, 1.1, 1.6 permille): who they apply to and the legal consequences (fines, points, driving bans, criminal offence). Text in German.

tools.name: drinks_to_reach_permille
tools.description: How many servings of a drink bring a person to a given blood alcohol level (e.g. "how many beers are 0.5 permille"), as a range: the low end assumes a 10 % resorption deficit and slow elimination, the high end 30 % and fast elimination. With hours_of_drinking > 0 the drinks are spread over that time

tools.name: convert_breath_blood_alcohol
tools.description: Convert breath alcohol (mg/l, what a roadside breathalyser measures) to blood alcohol (permille) or back, at the German legal ratio 1:2000 (0.25 mg/l = 0.5 permille). Give exactly one of breath_mg_per_l or blood_permille. The individual ratio varies, so the result is the legal equivalent, not a meas

tools.name: drink_driving_limits_europe
tools.description: Blood alcohol limits for car drivers in 25 European countries, with the stricter limits for novice, young or professional drivers. Optional country: ISO code (AT, IT, GB-ENG, GB-SCT …) or German or English name; without it, all countries. Country names and notes in German.
